sectionConfigSyncDesc:
Syncs: app config and themes (the plugin system already syncs by default).

How: calls Export Settings in Settings → About, and copies theme folders into data\storage\petal\fhelper\config-sync so SiYuan can sync them.

How to use:
1. On device A, click “Write config → cache” to write data into the data folder.
2. On device B, click “Write cache → config”: it syncs first, then writes settings and themes into app conf and restarts so they take effect.
3. Manually select the theme in Settings.
configSyncPushed: Config written to cache (SiYuan sync still required for other devices)
configSyncRestartDesc: Config and themes have been written from cache. Click OK to automatically restart SiYuan and apply them. After restart, select the theme manually in Settings.
configSyncRestartDescMobile: Config and themes have been written from cache. Click OK to refresh the UI. If some settings do not apply, fully quit and reopen SiYuan. Then select the theme manually in Settings.
configSyncUpToDate: Cache is already up to date
configSyncNoPack: No config data in cache yet
configSyncFailed: Config cache operation failed; see console logs
configSyncSyncFailed: Sync failed; cache was not written to config
configSyncSyncTimeout: Sync timed out; cache was not written to config
configSyncSyncDisabled: Cloud sync is off; cannot pull cache
imageScaleEnableDesc: Apply to all images using system DPI: fixed px when DPI width is below editor content width, calc(100% - 8px) otherwise; refreshes on resize (including manually adjusted images).
imageScaleCenterDesc: Injects global CSS: .p:has(span.img) { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; } without changing block attributes.
autoDpiCompensatedLabel: System DPI: ${dpi} (${percent}%). Siyuan UI zoom ${appZoomPercent}% excluded (devicePixelRatio ${rawPercent}%).
autoDpiUnavailable: Cannot read system DPI; image scaling is unavailable.
panguSpacingEnable: Auto space between CJK and Latin
panguSpacingEnableDesc: Real-time spacing in the DOM while typing; paste is normalized via textPlain, textHTML, and siyuanHTML before render. Spaces around inline code stay outside the code mark. Skips IME composition, code blocks, and title blocks.
docRefStyleEnableDesc: Show document icon, bold text, and underline only on auto-inserted child-nav refs. Manual refs are unchanged; nothing is written into the document body.
childDocWidgetEnableDesc: When a document opens, missing auto refs for direct-child docs are appended at the end as H5 headings wrapping a document block-ref. Auto blocks carry a custom attribute so they stay distinct from manual refs: missing children are created, leftover auto blocks are deleted. They are part of the document body and appear in the outline natively.
sectionDefaultIconsDesc: Applies only to notebooks and documents that have no custom icon. Click the icon to use SiYuan’s picker; Restore returns the official default.
defaultIconNotebookDesc: Default icon for notebooks in the file tree.
defaultIconFolderDesc: Default icon when a document has sub-documents.
defaultIconFileDesc: Default icon when a document has no sub-documents.
defaultIconPickerUnavailable: This SiYuan version does not expose the icon picker. Please upgrade.

moveDocsByNavBlocksBreadcrumbTip:
Move documents from nav blocks under this page
After moving document-ref blocks here, click to move those documents under this page as children. Do not switch pages first, or missing-child sync will delete those blocks.

deleteChildrenWithoutNavBreadcrumbTip:
Delete child docs that have no nav block
First delete the nav blocks you do not want, stay on this page, then click to remove those child documents. Switching pages first will auto-recreate the blocks.
deleteChildrenWithoutNavNone: “${doc}”: nothing to delete — every direct child already has an auto nav block
deleteChildrenWithoutNavDone: “${doc}”: deleted ${count} child document(s) that had no nav block
deleteChildrenWithoutNavFailed: Failed to delete child documents without nav blocks
